lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello sir, main CBI headquarters Delhi se baat kar raha hoon. Aapka naam ek bade scam mein aaya hai.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Agar aapne cooperate nahi kiya to aapko aaj hi giraftaar kar lenge.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Yeh national security ka mamla hai, aap kisi se baat nahi kar sakte.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Abhi turant apne account ki details aur OTP bataiye taaki hum verify kar sakein.
